selections.comment: The key form line to this race will be the County Hurdle contested by Absurde (3rd), Spirit D'Aunou (5th), Our Champ (6th), DADDY LONG LEGS (10th) and Hansard (13th). Our Champ had the run of the race from the front that day and may struggle to confirm form with the Mullins pair and repeat last year's success in this off a 13lb higher mark. Absurde took the 2024 renewal of that Cheltenham race and his classy flat form since suggests that his lofty mark of 148 is workable. It was DADDY LONG LEGS who was most inconvenienced by the way the race developed that day and he should get a much stronger pace to aim at here. If the rain stays away he can provide his trainer with another needed victory as he bids to retain his championship.

Back on favourable good ground he could complete the places.

selections.comment: BUSY BEING BUSY faces his stiffest test to date but can complete a hat trick. He was going away at the finish last time and his previous win has been franked emphatically so a further 5lb rise shouldn't stop him. Mr Freedom has a decent record here and ran well on return from a lay off last time. The winner that day franked the form at the Ayr festival so he should remain competitive. Electric Mason didn't look an easy ride last time but was far from disgraced in the Martin Pipe a notoriously strong handicap which has already worked out well. He isn't ruled out in an open contest.

While 7th of 8 he wasn't beaten that far and takes a massive drop in class here. He will be very tough to beat even first-time out. Newcomers Arctic Grey and Rogue Millions look the most likely to upset the favourite being unknown quantities from good yards and with significant price tags.

Yoshimi is a danger having idled in front when winning last time and perhaps having a little more to come. Swiss Ace has a chance on ratings, but the drop back to 6f may not suit.
